title: Entity text search
responsibility: Ranks revision-bound entity search results using names, identifiers, purpose and contract terms.

inputs.name: entitySearch.entries
inputs.description: Searchable entities retaining their category and commit.

inputs.name: entitySearch.query
inputs.description: Whitespace-separated query words, matched case-insensitively. Every word must match an entry.

inputs.name: entitySearch.limit
inputs.description: Maximum returned results, defaulting to 20; applied with array slicing.

outputs.name: entitySearch
outputs.description: Matching entries ranked by exact name/id, name prefix, id-part prefix, name-word prefix, name/id substring, purpose and contract-term matches. Ties use category order then name. Blank queries return no results.
